body.heading: Where in the world is Paraguay?
paragraphs: Paraguay is a country in South America.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Paraguay is Asunción.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Paraguay speak Spanish and Guarani.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Paraguay is the Paraguayan guarani.

body.heading: How big is Paraguay?
paragraphs: Paraguay covers about 407,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Chile.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Trinidad de Paraná is the best-preserved of Paraguay's Jesuit mission towns — red stone churches and carved Guarani art in peaceful countryside.
The capital Asunción mixes colonial buildings, the pink Palacio de los López and a lively costanera promenade along the Paraguay River.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Paraguay on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
